instructions: For one user story and one acceptance criterion, decide whether the criterion verifies the story. Choose verifies only when the criterion's observable result directly covers the story. Choose unrelated when it does not or when one side is missing.

labels.name: verifies
labels.description: The acceptance criterion directly verifies the user story.

story.text: As a reader, a reading view dims the internals in place, so the clauses written for me stand out and nothing moves or hides.

criterion.text: When the reviewer turns reading view on, internals clauses are dimmed in place and readable, and no clause moves or hides.

story.text: As a reviewer, I need an entirely unrelated fixture outcome.

criterion.text: The unrelated fixture outcome is observable.

labels.name: unrelated
labels.description: The acceptance criterion does not verify the user story, or one side has no matching text.

story.text: As a reader, a reading view dims the internals in place, so the clauses written for me stand out and nothing moves or hides.

criterion.text: When the reviewer clicks Move comment here, the orphaned thread is resolved and a draft comment at that section quotes the original, with no new event type.

story.text: As the operator, I can see for any suggestion which model, question set, and sources produced it, and with what confidence.
